title: Proxmox guest backup schedule
summary: Install guest backup wrappers and systemd schedules with explicit retention and storage choices.
requirements: Mounted backup storage and verified available capacity
Explicit guest IDs, backup mode, retention and schedule
Restore procedure covering external bind mounts separately
Storage access and encryption policy reviewed
verification: Inspect installed systemd timer schedules and service commands
Run an approved backup separately and inspect its exit status and archive
Restore a backup into an isolated guest and verify application data
